names.note: Name page 2617 of days.pravoslavie.ru is «Святая Милица, княгиня Сербская»: «Святая» is "saint", «княгиня» is the princely rank and «Сербская» stands in the heading as an attribute of that rank, so the form is bare — the reading made for `olga-of-kyiv` on the Julian 11 July. The two monastic names, Eugenia and Euphrosyne, are in the row note. `fk.mjs` returns NONE for «милица».

death.note: The day line closes «(1405)» and life4270 gives the day: «Скончалась в этом монастыре схимницей 11 ноября 1405 года». No year of birth.

source.text: Православный церковный календарь, Сретенский монастырь (days.pravoslavie.ru), 19 июля ст. ст. — «Прав. Стефана Высокого, деспота Сербского (1427) и матери его Милицы (1405).»

attestations.note: The day's seventh entry carries a mother and a son; the son is `stefan-the-tall` and is upgraded, and this is the mother, whom no folder held — `fk.mjs` on «Милица» returns NONE, and `militsa-kuvshinova` is a twentieth-century namesake. Index id2617 lists TWO readings and both were read, life6935 and life4270, AND THEY NAME DIFFERENT MONASTERIES for her tonsure: «в Жупаневачский монастырь около Крушевака с именем Евгении» in 1393 against «Основала женский монастырь Любостинь, в котором постриглась с именем Евгения». The monastic name agrees and the house does not, and both are in the life. HER OWN PAGE PRINTS A SECOND DAY: «Дни памяти: 19 июля , 30 августа (Серб.)», and the second is labelled Serbian; this row stands on the 19th, which is the day page that listed her, and the 30 August is recorded here and not made a feast. The two monastic names, Eugenia at her tonsure and Euphrosyne at the great schema, are in the life. The day page prints no hymn under her name.
